description: Populated decision register for Oracle Gate B review. All D1–D9 plus U1 are frozen. This JSON is review/test evidence, not a second normative authority — the active spec §6 T1a subsection and S0 plan §3.1 are the sole normative truth. All decided_at dates herein are noncanonical JSON-evidence timestamps, not canonical Markdown frontmatter timestamps governed by D1.

approval_evidence.method: Explicit user decisions in this session — D1–D6 and D8–D9 resolved by user on 2026-07-23; D7 and U1 previously frozen and now confirmed for T1a traceability. No private locator or external evidence required.

decisions.summary: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ UTC, uppercase Z only, no offset/space/fractional seconds. Applies to created_at, decided_at, and review/approval timestamps in canonical frontmatter.

human:<slug> or agent:<slug>. Slug grammar [a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*, 1–64 code points, no whitespace/uppercase/consecutive delimiters. decided_by and reviewer must use human:. created_by and assessor.identity may use either.

Stdlib-only test parser; bounded block-style YAML subset. Exact line grammar frozen: 2-space indent, map scalar <key>: <scalar>, map container <key>:, sequence scalar <indent>- <scalar>, sequence container <indent>-, no blank lines, no map/sequence mixing. Frozen scalar dispatch order: token begins "→parse entire token as JSON double-quoted form; else exact []/{}→empty sentinels before plain checks; else plain. Plain scalar positional first-char restrictions: forbidden !, &, *, %, @, |, >, ", ', {, [, `; and -, ?, : only when followed by space/EOL; leading # forbidden; bare #anchor=... requires JSON quote; internal :  and  # forbidden within plain scalar; internal # not preceded by space (e.g. path.md#anchor=...) is plain data. JSON double-quoted string via stdlib json.loads for ambiguous content (starts with indicator, contains :  or  #, equals reserved typed token, needs escaping); post-decode string must be nonempty single-line printable, no CR/LF/ASCII controls, no leading/trailing whitespace; escaped newline/control cannot bypass. Single-quoted/YAML-specific quotes forbidden. Typed interpretation: true/false→bool, 0|[1-9][0-9]*→int, []/{}→empty collection, else string. Comments completely forbidden. Duplicate keys rejected at every level; unknown fields rejected. Deterministic error mapping: malformed/duplicate/unknown→primary profile_mismatch; candidate validation entry {check_id: frontmatter_profile, status: fail}; optional secondary validation_failed may appear ONLY in common envelope errors[] and cannot override primary profile_mismatch because of frozen total order.
decisions.summary_scope: This summary is a machine-readable synopsis. Validators MUST resolve and enforce the complete committed authority referenced by authority_refs. Any omission from this synopsis never creates permission; the authoritative specification at the referenced commits governs.

decisions.summary: Duplicate mapping keys rejected at every nesting level before any last-key-wins or silent-overwrite behavior. Fail closed with profile_mismatch per D3 deterministic error mapping.

Uppercase Crockford Base32: [0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26} (26 characters). Reject lowercase (a–z) and forbidden letters I, L, O, U. Prefixes use short forms per spec §6 exhaustive role-prefix list: ent-, route-, stmt-, ep-, assess-, asset-, rel-. Asset owner records use asset-<ULID> only. run-<ULID> retired.
UTF-8 without BOM. No CR (U+000D) bytes. LF (U+000A) exclusively for line endings. Exactly one trailing LF — no additional blank line bytes after it. Applies to all canonical Markdown files.

decisions.summary: Equality is semantic (parsed key/value pairs), not byte-order. Validators MUST NOT reject a record solely for key reordering. Sequence element order is normative where a field is semantically a list. Writers may produce stable display order for human readability but that order is not authority.

Rejected at every level including nested objects (e.g. assessor). Exact set is 7 common fields + required/optional additional fields for selected type/kind/overlay profile. Fail closed with profile_mismatch per D3 error mapping. approval_binding is NOT a nested frontmatter example — it is runtime CANDIDATE JSON/commit metadata. New frontmatter field requires reviewed protocol amendment or version change.
